2021 CLIMATE RESILIENCE S.R.O. 44
COMMONWEALTH OF DOMINICA
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS NO. 44 OF 2021.
ORDER
MADE by the Prime Minister under section 25 of the Climate
Resilience Act, 2018, (Act No. 16 of 2018).
(Gazetted 1st December, 2021.)
1. This Order may be cited as the – Short title.
CLIMATE RESILIENCE (EXTENSION
OF DURATION) ORDER, 2021.
2. In this Order, the Climate Resilience Act is referred to as Interpretation.
Act No. 16 of 2018.
“the Act”.
3. The Act is hereby extended for one further year until the Extension of duration.
31st day of December, 2023.
Made this 22nd day of November , 2021.
ROOSEVELT SKERRIT
Prime Minister
DOMINICA
Printed by the Government Printer at the Government Printery, Roseau
(Price $0.20 cents )
2021 CLIMATE RESILIENCE S.R.O. 44
message: Climate Resilience (Extension of duration) Order 2021 (SRO 44 of 2021) effective 2021-12-01, the Gazette date; extends the Act to 2023-12-31
